family: J_N=family.evaluate on ALL N actual bits, with cost-aware multiplicity/entropy SU guard q>2^30*h*d*s/rho, inverse-output response tuning, plateau/tail rows, variable active gaps and least weighted source certificate. First ties; fallback output0,t_N=u_N=d_plan=N+1.
theorem: For every fully guarded candidate, source_certificate computes u(p) as the minimum of original geometry d_plan, common-S certificate, and weighted certificate c_H+1+sum_u[T_u(S_u-1)+(O-1)], with O=rank+maxTheta+1 and S_u=rank+max(Y_childdepth,maxTheta+1)+3 from actual scalar recurrence SEL1. At the selected plan exact POS/DP threshold t_N<=u_N<=d_plan; C_B2(J_N)>=4N-8t_N+8>=4N-8u_N+8 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, u_N<=2^ceil(D_energy Z), D_energy=139833/50000=2.79666, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Consequently for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(J_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and this SAME fixed family has liminf C_B2(J_N)/N>=4.
